author: santiago
title: Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs
description: Crisp sourdough topped with lemony avocado, softly poached eggs, scallions, and a pinch of red pepper flakes.
steps: Toast the sourdough until the edges are crisp and golden.
Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Bring a shallow pan of water to a gentle simmer and poach the eggs for 3 to 4 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks remain soft.
Spread the avocado over the toast and place a poached egg on each serving.
Finish with sliced scallion and red pepper flakes, then serve immediately.

author: tiago
title: Creamy Blueberry Oatmeal
description: Warm rolled oats simmered in milk and finished with blueberries, honey, and cinnamon for an easy everyday breakfast.
steps: Combine the oats, milk, and salt in a small saucepan.
Cook over medium-low heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Fold in half of the blueberries and cook for 1 minute so they begin to soften.
Divide between bowls and top with the remaining blueberries, honey, and cinnamon.

author: ines
title: Spinach and Mushroom Omelet
description: A tender folded omelet filled with sautéed mushrooms, spinach, and melted cheddar cheese.
steps: Slice the mushrooms and sauté them in half of the butter over medium-high heat until browned.
Add the spinach and cook just until wilted, then season lightly and transfer the filling to a plate.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper until evenly combined.
Melt the remaining butter in the pan, add the eggs, and gently pull the cooked edges toward the center.
Add the mushroom mixture and cheddar to one half, fold the omelet, and cook for 1 more minute before serving.

author: santiago
title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Fluffy breakfast pancakes made with ripe banana and oats, served warm with maple syrup.
steps: Blend the oats until they have the texture of a coarse flour.
Mash the bananas, then whisk in the eggs and milk.
Stir in the ground oats and baking powder and rest the batter for 5 minutes.
Melt a little butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook small pancakes for about 2 minutes per side.
Serve the pancakes warm with maple syrup.

author: tiago
title: Berry Yogurt Parfait
description: Layers of creamy Greek yogurt, fresh berries, toasted oats, almonds, and honey.
steps: Toast the oats and chopped almonds in a dry skillet for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring frequently.
Slice the strawberries and combine them with the blueberries.
Layer yogurt, berries, and the toasted oat mixture in two glasses.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

author: ines
title: Classic Caprese Salad
description: Ripe tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil dressed simply with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella into rounds of similar thickness.
Arrange alternating slices of tomato and mozzarella on a serving plate.
Tuck basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

author: santiago
title: Roasted Pumpkin Soup
description: Silky roasted pumpkin soup with onion, garlic, ginger, and a gentle finish of cream.
steps: Cut the pumpkin into chunks, toss with half of the olive oil, and roast at 200°C for 30 minutes until tender and caramelized.
Sauté the chopped onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the roasted pumpkin and vegetable broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until completely smooth, then stir in the cream and nutmeg.
Adjust the seasoning and warm gently without boiling before serving.

author: tiago
title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
description: A bright salad of chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, feta, parsley, and lemon dressing.
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then pat them dry.
Dice the cucumber and tomatoes and thinly slice the red onion.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the vegetables, chickpeas, parsley, and crumbled feta and toss gently.
Rest for 10 minutes before serving so the flavors combine.

author: ines
title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Juicy shrimp quickly sautéed with garlic, butter, lemon, parsley, and a touch of chili.
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season lightly with salt.
Heat the olive oil and 1 tablespoon of butter in a wide skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the shrimp for 1 to 2 minutes per side, then transfer them to a plate.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and red pepper flakes in the remaining butter for 30 seconds.
Return the shrimp to the pan, add lemon juice and parsley, toss well, and serve immediately.

author: santiago
title: Tomato Basil Bruschetta
description: Grilled bread rubbed with garlic and topped with ripe tomatoes, basil, olive oil, and balsamic vinegar.
steps: Dice the tomatoes and combine them with chopped basil, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and salt.
Let the tomato mixture stand for 10 minutes while preparing the bread.
Slice the bread, brush lightly with olive oil, and grill or toast until crisp.
Rub each warm slice with a cut garlic clove.
Spoon the tomato mixture over the bread just before serving.

author: tiago
title: Mango Chicken with Rice
description: Tender chicken and bell pepper in a bright mango, ginger, and lime sauce, served with steamed rice.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it according to the package directions, then keep it covered and warm.
Blend half the mango with the soy sauce, lime juice, ginger, and 2 tablespoons of water until smooth.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces, season with salt and pepper, and brown it in the vegetable oil.
Add the sliced onion, bell pepper, and garlic and stir-fry until the vegetables are crisp-tender.
Pour in the mango sauce, simmer until the chicken is cooked through, fold in the remaining diced mango, and serve over rice.

author: ines
title: Ginger Beef Stir-Fry
description: Tender strips of beef stir-fried with peppers, broccoli, scallions, and a savory ginger-soy glaze.
steps: Slice the beef thinly across the grain and toss it with half of the soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Whisk the remaining soy sauce with sesame oil, ginger, garlic, and 2 tablespoons of water.
Sear the beef in a very hot skillet in two batches, then transfer it to a plate.
Stir-fry the broccoli and bell pepper for 4 minutes, adding a splash of water to help the broccoli steam.
Return the beef, add the sauce, and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy; finish with sliced scallions.

author: santiago
title: Lentil Curry with Basmati Rice
description: Comforting red lentils simmered with tomato, warming spices, a touch of cream, and fluffy basmati rice.
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear, then cook it according to the package instructions.
Sauté the diced onion in oil for 6 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, and turmeric and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes, lentils, and vegetable broth.
Simmer uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender; stir in the cream, season, and serve with the rice.

author: tiago
title: Lemon Salmon with Roasted Asparagus
description: Oven-roasted salmon and asparagus with lemon, garlic, olive oil, and fresh dill.
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C and line a large tray with parchment.
Trim the asparagus and toss it with half of the olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Place the salmon on the tray and brush it with the remaining oil, minced garlic, lemon zest, salt, and pepper.
Roast for 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily and the asparagus is tender-crisp.
Finish with lemon juice and chopped dill before serving.

author: ines
title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Slow-stirred rice with deeply browned mushrooms, white wine, parmesan, butter, and thyme.
steps: Keep the vegetable broth hot in a saucepan over low heat.
Brown the sliced mushrooms in 1 tablespoon of butter, season them, and set half aside for serving.
Cook the onion in the remaining butter until translucent, then add the garlic and rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Add the wine and stir until absorbed, then add hot broth one ladle at a time, stirring until each addition is nearly absorbed.
After 18 to 20 minutes, fold in the mushrooms, parmesan, and thyme; adjust the consistency with a final splash of broth and serve.

author: santiago
title: Chicken Tacos with Avocado Salsa
description: Spiced chicken tucked into warm tortillas with avocado, tomato, red onion, cilantro, and lime.
steps: Coat the chicken with cumin, smoked paprika, salt, pepper, and a little oil.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet for 6 to 7 minutes per side, then rest and slice it thinly.
Dice the avocado and tomato and combine them with red onion, cilantro, lime juice, and salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet until soft and lightly toasted.
Fill each tortilla with chicken and avocado salsa and serve with lime wedges.

author: tiago
title: Classic Beef Lasagna
description: Layers of slow-cooked beef and tomato sauce, creamy ricotta, pasta, mozzarella, and parmesan.
steps: Sauté the onion until soft, add the garlic and beef, and cook until the meat is well browned.
Stir in the tomato paste, tomato sauce, oregano, salt, and pepper and simmer gently for 35 minutes.
Cook the lasagna noodles until just flexible, then drain and lay them flat.
Spread a little meat sauce in a baking dish and layer noodles, ricotta, meat sauce, mozzarella, and parmesan; repeat three times.
Cover and bake at 190°C for 30 minutes, uncover for another 15 minutes, then rest for 15 minutes before slicing.

author: ines
title: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
description: A whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic, rosemary, thyme, and buttery pan juices.
steps: Pat the chicken completely dry and season the cavity and exterior generously with salt and pepper.
Mix the softened butter with chopped rosemary, thyme, minced garlic, and lemon zest and spread it under and over the skin.
Place the halved onion and one lemon inside the cavity and set the chicken in a roasting pan.
Roast at 200°C for 20 minutes, reduce to 180°C, and continue roasting for about 70 minutes, basting twice with the pan juices.
Confirm the thickest part of the thigh reaches 74°C, then rest the chicken for 15 minutes while making a quick pan sauce with the broth.

author: santiago
title: Eggplant Parmesan
description: Breaded eggplant layered with tomato sauce, mozzarella, parmesan, and basil, then baked until bubbling.
steps: Slice the eggplants into 1-centimeter rounds, salt both sides, and let them drain for 20 minutes before patting dry.
Dip each slice in beaten egg, coat with breadcrumbs, and arrange on oiled baking trays.
Bake at 220°C for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender.
Layer tomato sauce, eggplant, mozzarella, parmesan, and basil in a baking dish, finishing with cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until bubbling, then rest for 10 minutes before serving.

author: tiago
title: Shrimp Pad Thai
description: Rice noodles tossed with shrimp, egg, bean sprouts, peanuts, scallions, and a balanced lime-fish sauce glaze.
steps: Soak the rice noodles in warm water until flexible but still firm, then drain well.
Whisk the fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, and 2 tablespoons of water until the sugar dissolves.
Sear the shrimp in a hot wok with half of the oil until just cooked and transfer them to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, scramble the eggs, then add the noodles and sauce and toss until the noodles are tender.
Return the shrimp, fold in the bean sprouts and scallions, and serve topped with crushed peanuts and lime.

author: ines
title: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Spaghetti coated in a slow-simmered beef, tomato, carrot, celery, and red wine sauce.
steps: Finely dice the onion, carrot, and celery and cook them in olive oil over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and ground beef and cook until the beef is deeply browned.
Stir in the tomato paste, add the wine, and simmer until reduced by half.
Add the tomato sauce, salt, and pepper and simmer gently for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente, toss it with the sauce and a splash of pasta water, and serve with parmesan.

author: santiago
title: Gnocchi with Peas and Parmesan
description: Pillowy gnocchi in a light butter and parmesan sauce with sweet green peas, lemon, and parsley.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and add the gnocchi.
Melt the butter in a wide skillet and gently cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the peas and 1/2 cup of gnocchi cooking water and simmer for 3 minutes.
Transfer the floating gnocchi directly to the skillet and toss with parmesan until the sauce becomes glossy.
Finish with lemon zest, parsley, and black pepper.

author: tiago
title: Black Bean Burgers
description: Savory black bean patties with cumin and smoked paprika, served on toasted bread with avocado and tomato.
steps: Drain the beans very well and mash them, leaving some texture.
Sauté the onion and garlic until soft, then stir in the cumin and smoked paprika.
Mix the beans with the onion mixture, breadcrumbs, egg, salt, and pepper and form four firm patties.
Cook the patties in a lightly oiled skillet for 4 to 5 minutes per side until browned and heated through.
Serve on toasted bread with sliced avocado and tomato.

author: ines
title: Chicken and Vegetable Couscous
description: Fluffy couscous served with tender chicken, chickpeas, zucchini, carrot, pumpkin, and warm spices.
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and brown it in olive oil, then transfer it to a plate.
Sauté the onion until soft, then add the cumin and cinnamon for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pot, add the carrots, pumpkin, tomatoes, and 2 cups of broth, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the zucchini and chickpeas and continue cooking for 10 minutes, until all vegetables are tender.
Pour the remaining hot broth over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Serve the chicken, vegetables, and their broth over the couscous and finish with chopped parsley.

author: santiago
title: Strawberry Cheesecake
description: A creamy baked cheesecake on a crisp crumb crust, finished with fresh strawberry sauce.
steps: Mix the breadcrumbs with melted butter and 1/4 cup of sugar, press into a springform pan, and bake at 175°C for 10 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese with 3/4 cup of sugar until smooth, then mix in the eggs one at a time and fold in the sour cream.
Pour over the crust and bake at 160°C for 55 to 65 minutes, until the edges are set and the center still trembles slightly.
Cool gradually, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Simmer half of the strawberries with the remaining sugar, lemon juice, and cornstarch until glossy; cool and spoon over the cheesecake with the fresh berries.

author: tiago
title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
description: Dense chocolate brownies with a shiny top, deep cocoa flavor, and toasted walnuts.
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a 20-centimeter square pan with parchment.
Melt the butter and chocolate together over low heat, then cool for 5 minutes.
Whisk the sugar and eggs until slightly thickened, then slowly whisk in the chocolate mixture.
Fold in the flour, cocoa, salt, and chopped walnuts just until no dry streaks remain.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the edges are set but the center remains moist; cool fully before slicing.

author: ines
title: Apple Cinnamon Crumble
description: Tender cinnamon apples under a crisp oat, brown sugar, and butter topping.
steps: Peel, core, and slice the apples and toss them with lemon juice, cinnamon, and 1/4 cup of brown sugar.
Spread the apples evenly in a buttered baking dish.
Combine the oats, flour, remaining brown sugar, and salt, then rub in the cold butter until coarse crumbs form.
Scatter the topping over the apples and bake at 185°C for 40 to 45 minutes.
Rest for 10 minutes and serve while the filling is still warm.

author: santiago
title: Fresh Fruit Salad
description: A colorful mix of pineapple, mango, strawberries, kiwi, grapes, and orange in a light lime-honey dressing.
steps: Cut the pineapple, mango, strawberries, kiwi, and oranges into bite-size pieces.
Halve any large grapes and combine all the fruit in a large bowl.
Whisk the lime juice and honey until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the fruit, add the mint, and toss gently.
Chill for 15 minutes or serve immediately.

author: tiago
title: Classic Hummus with Pita
description: Smooth chickpea and tahini hummus served with warm pita, olive oil, paprika, and parsley.
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas, reserving a few tablespoons of their liquid.
Blend the tahini and lemon juice for 1 minute until pale and creamy.
Add the chickpeas, garlic, cumin, salt, and olive oil and blend until very smooth, adding reserved liquid as needed.
Warm the pita bread in a dry skillet or low oven and cut it into wedges.
Spoon the hummus into a bowl and finish with olive oil, paprika, and chopped parsley.

author: ines
title: Vanilla Iced Coffee
description: Chilled espresso shaken with milk, vanilla, a touch of brown sugar, and plenty of ice.
steps: Stir the brown sugar and scraped vanilla seeds into the hot espresso until dissolved.
Let the sweetened espresso cool for 5 minutes.
Fill two tall glasses with ice and divide the milk between them.
Pour in the espresso, stir well, and serve immediately.
